description: This Java class 'TransfersDataValidator' provides validation methods for various transfer-related JSON data payloads in the Fineract project, including client transfers between groups, proposing, accepting, rejecting, and withdrawing transfers.

classes.name: TransfersDataValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates JSON data for various client transfer operations within the Fineract system.

methods.name: validateForClientsTransferBetweenGroups
methods.description: Validates JSON input for transferring clients between groups, checking required parameters and their values.

methods.name: validateForProposeClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON input for proposing a client transfer, ensuring necessary fields are present and valid.

methods.name: validateForAcceptClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON input for accepting a client transfer, including optional staff and group IDs.

methods.name: validateForProposeAndAcceptClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON for combined propose and accept transfer operations.

methods.name: validateForRejectClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON input for rejecting a client transfer, primarily checking for a note.

methods.name: validateForWithdrawClientTransfer
methods.description: Validates JSON input for withdrawing a client transfer, primarily checking for a note.

methods.name: validateNote
methods.description: Helper method to validate the length of the note field in transfer operations.
